metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-123. - Developer responsibility.
content.summary:
It shall be the responsibility of the requesting party to pay for all costs associated
               with the installation of street lighting.
(Code 1960, § 21-18; Code 1981, § 30-120; Ord. No. 2942, § 1, 12-17-1992)
